note: The ONLY place two differently-spelled names in this domain may become one person, in data/research/newspapers/identity.json's shape and under its rules: a merge needs a rule, the rule names BOTH spellings verbatim, and a surname-only merge is always a refusal. A refusal is declared as explicitly as a merge — the absence of one reads like a pair nobody has looked at yet.

passes.what: Every one of the 847 people in the 1835 residents layer tried against every personal entry in Norris 1844, on surname-fold plus first initial. The result — 48 clean matches, 15 ambiguous, 4 contested and 171 surname-only refusals — is written out person by person in norris_1844_crosswalk_1835.json beside this file, because a crosswalk between two LAYERS is not the same object as a merge of two SPELLINGS inside this domain, and the two do not belong in one list.
passes.rule: Under the ratified grading ladder an 1844 listing alone never makes an 1835 resident. Nothing in that file has been spent on a resident record; T-0569 is the ticket that spends it.
